scope: Opposing-team hero visibility transitions in four supplied replays; packet time and observed byte forms only.
limitations: Labels are binary inferences cross-checked against team, spawn, respawn and position; no independent game-UI verification.
Numeric observer-team labels are semantically inferred; no general enum byte transform.
Initial visibility remains unknown until the first transition; allied-team visibility not modeled.
Nonhero objects, map-region fog, wards, stealth/true sight and individual camera knowledge are not reconstructed.
Death/respawn does not automatically change visibility; keep the actual transition, including the 842.528-second exception.
Filtered health/resource/level samples are last observed values, never hidden-state predictions. Enemy economy and planned paths remain excluded.
